salesCopy.tagline: Stop Starting from Zero Every Time You Open ChatGPT or Claude
salesCopy.secondaryTagline: Give AI the Context It Needs to Actually Help You
salesCopy.problem: Every time you open `ChatGPT` or `Claude`, you start from zero. AI gives you generic responses because it doesn't know who you are, what you do, or what you need. You waste **10+ minutes per session** typing the same context again. The output still feels off; not quite you.
problemPoints: Generic AI responses that miss your actual situation
Wasting **10+ minutes** typing context every session
AI-generated content that sounds robotic instead of like you
Copy-pasting the same background info repeatedly
Knowing there's a better way but not finding it
salesCopy.agitate: You have access to remarkable AI tools, but you treat them like a stranger every session. No wonder the outputs feel generic. You spend more time explaining than getting work done. I spent **years** figuring this out before I found the solution.
agitatePoints: Starting every AI conversation from scratch
The gap between AI's potential and your reality
Frustration with tools that should help you
salesCopy.solution: AI Master Prompts give AI context about you **before** you ask questions. Instead of starting from zero, AI already knows who you are, what you do, your preferences, your goals, and your style. The result? Responses that fit your situation from the first message. This workshop shares the framework I use daily to make AI work like a personalized assistant.
solutionPoints: AI that knows your context from the first message
Your background loaded automatically every time
Responses that match your voice and style
Connects with your existing knowledge base
Foundation for building AI assistants and agents
salesCopy.description: This workshop shares the **complete framework** for building AI Master Prompts that change how you work with LLMs. You'll learn the fundamentals of how large language models actually work, why context is everything, and exactly how to structure prompts that make AI understand **YOU**. Includes a **live demo** showing my actual AI writing assistant in action, creating content that matches my voice. Plus, you'll discover how to connect your prompts with your knowledge base using [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](/product/model-context-protocol) for truly dynamic, context-aware AI interactions.
highlights: **Better AI Output**: Transform generic responses into personalized results
**Works Everywhere**: Framework applies to ChatGPT, Claude, and any LLM
**Implement Today**: Create your master prompt during the workshop
**Expert-Led**: Practical AI techniques from daily professional use
**Knowii Ecosystem**: Included in [Knowii Community](/product/knowii-community), [Knowledge Worker Kit](/product/knowledge-worker-kit) & [Everything Bundle](/product/everything-knowledge-bundle)

immediate: AI responses that fit your actual situation

Better output quality from your first session
